easy.def: A word for a thing or animal that was just named.
examples: I found my hat. It is red.
The puppy is small, and it is soft.

more.def: A word used instead of the name of a thing, an animal, or an idea that has already been mentioned.
examples: The river was wide, but we crossed it on a bridge.
I lost my notebook, and I cannot find it anywhere.
It is cold and rainy outside today.
